call_chain: tf_route (parse.rs:2901) checks only the general threshold len <= TF_N (65536), then tf_class samples up to TF_SAMPLE=256 bytes and classifies control/zero/digit proportions. With TF_TEXT=0, only kind 2 is returned by this route.
If kind==2, TZ_ON=1 selects run_z. The planner+emit branch exists in parse but is not selected for the current kind-2 route; ordinary text returns kind 3 and proceeds to sniff.
sniff (parse.rs:206) samples up to SAMPLE=2048 bytes and selects DNA-like, text, high-entropy binary, other binary, zero-rich high-entropy, prose, or structured-text classes.

st_route (parse.rs:626) only considers class 2 or 4 with len > ST_MIN=65536. st_phase (parse.rs:592) samples up to ST_SAMPLE=4096 byte pairs; it routes only when one parity has at most ST_FEW=32 distinct values and the other at least ST_MANY=160. run_st (parse.rs:695) searches every other position with a three-byte direct-mapped table and accepts distances ST_DMIN=129 through ST_DMAX=32768.

e_kind (parse.rs:1024) sends classes 1, 5, 6 at len <= TM_MAX=65536 to run1t with T_SKIP. At larger lengths, class 1 and class 6 meet r1_kind single-step conditions and use run1 with T_SKIP; class 5 has P_DEPTH=4 and uses the P_SKIP path.
DN_ON=0 makes the DNA branch inactive. R1_ON=1 and the current one-step class depths enable the read-ahead run1 path for qualifying classes.

hardcoding_review.exact_input_length_match: No input.len()==literal file-size branch found in the active entry/classifier search.
hardcoding_review.exact_content_signature: No file name, digest, or fixed header signature found in the active routing chain; routing uses sampled byte-category histograms and parity diversity.
hardcoding_review.generic_thresholds: TF_N, TM_MAX, SMALL and ST_MIN are general cutoffs, not exact-file matches.

comparison.probe3_261: Shares fastX class sniffing, hash-chain search, lazy choice, backward token merge and skip acceleration. The exported #432 parser adds the run1 read-ahead path and stride-2 pair-structured binary path. #432 has T_SKIP=4 and T_DEPTH=1; probe3 has T_SKIP=3 and T_DEPTH=3.
comparison.source_407: Both use content-dependent routing, but #407 parse starts with a quick RLE sample, can consume an fl_part prefix, then dispatches the remainder through sampled entropy/mode lanes. #432 routes directly from tf_route/sniff into run_z, run1t, run_st, run1 or the general hash-chain run; its special structural-binary path is parity-based.

proof_risk.source_proof: Parse.lean contains parse_spec at line 4463, plus skip_len_spec (3141), run1_spec (3647), run1t_spec (4027), st_slot_spec (4119), st_find_spec (4185), and run_st_spec (4306).
proof_risk.documented_constant_constraints: T_SKIP is a skip shift with skip<32 (global shifts <=31); ST_DMIN is free; ST_HB must be 1..64; ST_HN >=1; ST_DMAX <=32768.
proof_risk.local_verification: Not run. The source pair was not compiled, and no axiom audit, round trip, stage1 gate rerun or benchmark was performed.

recommended_variants.name: T_SKIP4_to_3
recommended_variants.active_path: Current T_SKIP=4 is active for e_kind small classes 1/5/6 via run1t; large text class 1 and structured-text class 6 select run1 with T_SKIP. Large prose class 5 uses P_SKIP=5 because P_DEPTH=4, so it is not affected.
recommended_variants.mechanism: skip_len=min(miss >> skip, skcap); lowering the shift from 4 to 3 starts skipping earlier and advances farther, reducing search density. The current shift 4 is denser than probe3/261 shift 3.
recommended_variants.risk: One constant in existing paths; proof requires skip < 32 and the general constant policy caps shifts at 31. skip_len_spec, run1_spec and run1t_spec are present. Expected direction is speed versus possible ratio loss; measure both axes.

recommended_variants.name: ST_DMIN129_to_257
recommended_variants.active_path: Only affects inputs with ST_ON=1, length > ST_MIN, class 2 or 4, and st_phase parity diversity at most ST_FEW=32 versus at least ST_MANY=160 in up to ST_SAMPLE=4096 pairs.
recommended_variants.mechanism: st_find accepts distances ST_DMIN..ST_DMAX. Existing source comment says 129 keeps distance symbols 14..29; 257 would restrict them to 16..29. This is a compression-alphabet hypothesis, not an expected result.
recommended_variants.risk: Lean constants section marks ST_DMIN free; st_find_spec and run_st_spec cover the path. No new code path or proof statement is required, but run the official gate after a change.

c_batch.deferred_alternative: ST_HB=16 / ST_HN=65536 also satisfies documented st_slot constraints and halves direct-table initialization, with more collisions. Defer it to avoid a third variant and keep the two-variant batch interpretable.
